lifecycle.setup: In the official Grok Bot app, create a Bot from bot-profile.md and enable packaged skills from packaged-skills/. Do not use Grok CLI.
lifecycle.upgrade: Replace the Bot description from a newer bot-profile.md and replace owned packaged skills. Do not fetch at runtime.
lifecycle.remove: Disable or delete the owned Bot and its enabled Conquistador skills in the Grok Bot app. Leave other Bots.
